title: Ben Tzitzit HaKeset
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:2](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Taanit.4.2.13) says he belonged to Avner’s family. [Gittin 56a](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.56a.8) says he was one of Jerusalem’s three wealthy men at the time of the destruction. He was called this because the fringes of his garment trailed over cushions. Others say it was because his cushion was placed among the grandees of Rome.[^1]

notes.text: [Rashi on the first explanation](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Gittin.56a.8.2) takes the word tzitzit to mean the fringes of a tallit. In [his gloss on the alternative](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Gittin.56a.8.4), keset is the seat Ben Tzitzit occupied among Roman dignitaries.
